_comment: The bean graph. `beans/` is a graph whose DIRECTORIES are declared here — the same shape as `cat-harness.json`, reusing `ContentDirectorySchema` and the same open graph-kind registry rather than a parallel vocabulary. `graphs` is an array because a directory is a place to look and may hold more than one part of the graph; it does NOT say how to tell the contents apart, because the files declare what they are (a bean's front matter, a workflow instance's `$schema`). Paths resolve against THIS file's directory, so the whole graph relocates by moving one folder. Schema: schemas/bean-graph.ts. NOTE: `.beans.yml` still carries the defs path because the `beans` binary is third-party; `bun run check:harness-dirs` fails when they disagree. ihris declares only `defs`: it runs no BPMN workflow instances, so no `workflows/` directory exists (qa.py bean-graph check, 2026-09-23).
name: ihris

directories.description: Work items — one Markdown file each, in the layout the `beans` CLI reads.
